control_profile: Causal 28-day BTC state budgets, exposure-reducing adverse-price discounts, seven-day overlapping cohorts, volatility scaling, drawdown brakes, position stops and turnover throttling.
falsifier: The repaired price discount and slower cohort book fail to lift net return, role breadth and cost efficiency, or a market-state allocation merely disguises negative carry economics.
formation_horizon: robust seven-day and twenty-eight-day settled funding with a twenty-eight-day BTC state and nine-bar residual price protection
hypothesis: Settled funding carry survives when crowded shorts are concentrated in falling or neutral names, actual exposure is reduced during adverse idiosyncratic moves, and the long/short budget follows a slow causal crypto market state.
rebalance_horizon: one daily cohort averaged across seven overlapping daily vintages
